# Community Health Evidence Brief

Capability ID: community-health-evidence-brief-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/community-health-evidence-brief-v1/index.html
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- community health data
- county health evidence brief
- public health grant research
- health indicators for a community
- public health planning data

## Problem

Community-health planning and grant work requires many public indicators assembled into one sourced, understandable picture.

## Inputs

Geography, planning/grant question, target population where appropriate and requested public indicators.

## Outputs

Geography-specific public-health evidence brief with indicator provenance, gaps, comparisons and uncertainty.

## Pricing

Current hypothesis $250-$2,500 per brief; not auto-quotable yet.

## Invocation and authority

Discoverable capability; brief-specific source verification required before fulfillment.

Public-health research/education only, not medical advice or diagnosis. Paid scope requires explicit confirmation.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
